info.name: Services.AutoTrading Account Values Proxy Voting API

params.name: $skip
params.description: The number of entries to skip from the beginning of the collection

params.name: $top
params.description: The number of entries to return from the beginning of the collection

params.name: ClientKey
params.description: Client identifier to get events for

params.name: SortColumn
params.description: Specify a column to sort on. Default sorting on records is descending by ReceivedDate and ascending by IssuerName.

params.name: SortType
params.description: Specify ascending or descending sort. Default sort type will be Ascending.

items.docs: Get proxy voting events for client. Requires separate license.
